messages:
incidents-bot: @channel Heads-up: we’re seeing elevated 5xx and tail latency for Dedicated customers in eu-west3 after a kernel update affecting the 70B-qt runtime. Impact: partial degradation for some tenants. Status page: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/1778881234 — current state: mitigations in progress

alana (oncall): Oncall here. Triggered ~04:12 UTC after kernel upgrade. Multiple OOMs on 4x A100 nodes running 70B-qt, manifests as process restarts and KV cache thrashing. Affected endpoint: POST /v1/generate (70B-qt) for dedicated pools in eu-west3.

eva (sre): Observed OOMs lead to eviction storms -> large increase in p99 latency and error spikes. Autoscaler was constrained by backpressure on scheduler queue, so scaling didn’t compensate fast enough. Collecting heap/alloc traces now.

mike (infra): Mitigation steps implemented: 1) Pinned new incoming traffic to 70B-int8 fallback pool for dedicated customers in eu-west3. 2) Reduced default batch_size to 1 for 70B-qt to avoid large allocations. 3) Restarted 3 affected pods to clear bad kernel state. Rolling out across remaining nodes now.

deploy-bot: Rollback started: rollback-id deploy-2026-03-23-eu3-ker-rollback (targets: kernel-driver v2.14 -> v2.13). Progress: 3/3 pods rolled back in eu-west3 (canary -> complete).

raj (eng-runtime): Preliminary root cause: regression in the kernel allocator interaction with our mmap alignment for KV cache when using new kernel. Patch to allocator in review; if rollback doesn't fully resolve, we'll hotfix runtime allocator tomorrow morning.

sophie (support): Support draft ready for affected Dedicated customers: short explain, mitigation note, ETA for follow-up. Want to send in ~15m after we confirm stability. @claire (ops) can you sign off on tone + CC list for top 10 tenants?

claire (ops): :thumbsup: Approve send after we have 10m of stable telemetry (no new OOMs, error rate <5%). Please CC AEs for the top 10 impacted accounts and include the status link.

alana (oncall): Quick stats after routing changes: error rate for eu-west3 70B-qt dropped from ~12% -> ~2%. p99 latency on rolled-back nodes improved from 2.8s -> 1.1s. Still monitoring KV cache evictions on remaining nodes. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/ops/eu-west3-70b

incidents-bot: Status update 04:36 UTC: majority of customer traffic mitigated via routing + rollback. Incident state: monitoring. Next update in 30m or immediately on major change. If you are debugging, please attach logs to the incident thread and tag @eva (sre) or @raj (eng-runtime).
